entities.name: UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine N-acyltransferase
observations: The 359-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q136B3 from Rhodopseudomonas palustris BisB5.
Reviewed homologs Q2IW89 and B3Q7J5 show 83.8% and 71.7% identity over the full sequence, respectively.
The protein is annotated as a homotrimer and contains an LpxD domain (PF04613) at residues 33–100 plus Hexapep-family regions.
A reviewed reference annotates residue 256 as a proton acceptor active-site residue.

entities.name: LpxD acylation reaction
observations: The enzyme transfers a 3-hydroxyacyl group from acyl carrier protein to the amino group at C-2 of UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine N-acyltransferase participates in bacterial lipid A biosynthesis, producing a phosphorylated glycolipid component that anchors lipopolysaccharide in the outer membrane.
